description: React component for the Mattermost admin console's server logs page, including log fetching, filtering, pagination, and UI rendering.

classes.name: Logs
classes.description: React component class for displaying and managing server logs in the admin console.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state with default values and props.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Triggers log data reload when component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Reloads logs if page changes or plainLogs data is empty.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Increments the current page number for pagination.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Decrements the current page number for pagination.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Fetches logs based on current filters and log format.

methods.name: onLogFormatToggle
methods.description: Handles toggling between JSON and plain text log formats.

methods.name: onSearchChange
methods.description: Updates search term and triggers search filtering.

methods.name: performSearch
methods.description: Filters logs based on search term, excluding 'level' and 'timestamp' keys.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Cancels any pending search debounce when component unmounts.

methods.name: onFiltersChange
methods.description: Updates filter criteria and reloads logs.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the logs page UI, including filters, toggle, buttons, and log list.
